title: Very heavy and will rust
text: Very heavy and will rust. Although the size is nice this company could have and should have made a full square surface 15 by 15 or 16 by 16. The only real negative is very overpriced. And lastly while it might bake a little better than a stone, if you buy a good quality 1/2" stone probably work just as good, physically lighter, and heat up nicely

product_metadata.title: Baking Steel - The Original Ultra Conductive Pizza Stone (14"x16"x1/4")
features: Pizza stone made of Ultra-Conductive Steel. We know, we Invented it.
Unbreakable. Cooks 20 X faster than a pizza stone or baking stone.
The Original Baking Steel inspired by Modernist Cuisine
Great as a stovetop griddle, induction plate and even as a cold plate after it’s been frozen

description: The Original Baking Steel. Inspired by Modernist Cuisine, the Baking Steel is more conductive cooking surface than stone and stores up to 18 x more energy than a traditional pizza stone. Because of that conductivity, it cooks faster and more evenly at a lower temperature, resulting in beautiful, thin, crispy crust. WE DO NOT SHIP TO P.O. BOXES.
